_comment: Commands must go through `uv run`: this project installs ruff and pytest as dev dependencies, so bare `ruff`/`pytest` are not on PATH and a hook using them fails silently.

hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read f; case "$f" in *.py) uv run --no-sync ruff format "$f" && uv run --no-sync ruff check --fix "$f";; esac; }
